notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1. lookup_part found neither the Ethernet Shield nor the SCP1000 breakout, so both are new part types.
Correction to the step 1 note: the manual text, circuit image and schematic agree. D6 goes to DRDY and D7 goes to CSB (the schematic crosses the lines to show this).
The SPI wires follow the image and schematic: D13 to SCK, D12 to MOSI, D11 to MISO. This matches the image even though the sketch comment lists MOSI=11 and MISO=12.
The sensor is powered from the 3.3 V pin (red wire) and grounded through the shield's first Gnd pin (black wire). These are the power-header pins the image shows.
The Uno sits under the Ethernet shield. I modelled this as one joined edge with no ports, plus electrical pass-through edges for the pins the circuit uses.
No breadboard is used. The Ethernet cable to the network is not a circuit part, so it is not modelled.
